title: Evaluating GPT-4 and ChatGPT on Japanese Medical Licensing Examinations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on the performance of LLMs on Japanese medical licensing examinations, which includes topics on medical knowledge, clinical practice, and medical ethics/law specific to Japan (e.g., euthanasia).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
